facts.quote: Meanwhile, programmatic systems are pulling in [96.8%]

facts.quote: holding steady at 96% in 2026, according to EMARKETER forecasts

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article on pitching programmatic advertising was published on 25 September 2025.
StackAdapt's suggested pilot timeline includes a two-week ramp period followed by a 4–6-week measurement period.
facts.quote: Two-week ramp, immediate optimization, 4–6-week measurement period.

facts.fact: StackAdapt recommends that a pilot campaign choose one or two ad formats.
facts.quote: Choose one or two formats (like native + CTV), target a single audience segment, and set a realistic budget.

facts.fact: StackAdapt recommends that a pilot campaign be built around one clear objective.
facts.quote: Define one clear goal (e.g., drive form submissions or boost brand lift).
